purpose: Revised concept: move equip/disassemble to selected detail panel upper right. Not yet implemented in game.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Asset type: revised RuneNexus turret module UX design proposal.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the filled-metal teal equip and copper disassemble styling established in this first proposal.
Primary request: move ONLY the "장착" and "분해 · 다이아 50" buttons from the bottom of the selected-module details panel to the UPPER RIGHT corner INSIDE THE SAME selected-module details panel. They must be side by side, equip on the left and disassemble on the right, grouped as compact clear actions. This refers to the rectangular selected-module panel directly under the large turret/three equipped-module diagram, whose heading currently reads "유니크 · 과열 연산 코어" and whose effect currently reads "피해 +12%". Never place these buttons in the turret diagram above, inventory below, global page header, or a popup.
Composition: output one complete portrait screenshot mockup with same 440:900 aspect ratio and same resolution as reference. The selected module name and grade remain upper LEFT in their own allocated title area; allow that title to wrap naturally into TWO readable lines so that it does not compete with the right-hand action group. Both buttons sit within the upper-right corner with an internal margin equal to other panel content. At equivalent 440px screen width, equip button is approximately 54px wide, disassemble approximately 110px wide, both approximately 36px tall. One unobtrusive gap approximately 6px. They use the same straight-on chamfered metal silhouette and restrained filled teal / dark copper faces as the reference. Bold light labels stay easily legible. Preserve text verbatim: "장착", "분해 · 다이아 50", especially the amount 50. Disassemble may display its exact label on two lines inside its button for a clean compact layout, with "분해" above "다이아 50". Do NOT truncate or omit the diamond refund amount.
The effect description remains BELOW the title/action header row, left aligned, with clear empty space to the right. Show exact "피해 +12%" below the heading; no text must be covered by the controls. The old bottom action row is removed entirely and becomes plain panel background. Do NOT duplicate the buttons. Keep selected-panel outer dimensions and position unchanged so the whole page layout remains stable. Do not insert new visual divider cards or a new panel around the two buttons.
Invariants: preserve ALL screen layout outside this selected-module details panel, including top resources and draw buttons, turret selector, exact 3D turret image, connectors, three equipped module cards, inventory heading, part filters, inventory count42, "일괄 분해" button and its location/styling, inventory icons/grid, footer tabs, background, metal/rune theme. Preserve module identity, text and numerical state. No whole-screen redesign, no new buttons, no watermark, no device outline, no annotation text. Intent is a modest local UX improvement and an illustration proposal, not an actual game capture.
